episode_summary: This episode of Coffee Talks with DJ Paris and Tim Littleton focuses on a structured three-weekend system to optimize real estate listings. By emphasizing data collection, strategic launches, and timely adjustments, agents can ensure quicker sales and better client satisfaction. The discussion also highlights the importance of adapting strategies to fit varying market conditions.
